reviews.review:
This is a game very much of its time. I.e. pretty much a Gears of War clone, although I'm pretty sure 40K and the space marines vs orks was the inspiration for GOW conceptually.  The melee / HP system is unique in that it does DOOM (2016) style executions 5 years before that game, while also relying on it as the only way to regain health (except playing to the next checkpoint, dying, reloading, and then being a full HP). The problem for me is that melee combat never clicked for me and the game doesn't really incentives using melee through gameplay (as DOOM did). 

The main story is nothing to write home about, but I do like the side-stories told through the collection of servo skulls which contains audio logs (though I generally love this narrative device in games). Having said that, the world of Warhammer 40K is so intriguing that after playing for a while, I felt the urge to go and dig into the lore outside the game (which is a win for Games Workshop I suppose). 

Having said all this, I did play through the single player campaign and didn't feel like I wasted my time. If one accepts the game for what it is, there is some joy to extract from this game that is very much of its time.
If you like 40k then get this.

I bought this in 2023 for very few bucks (7 or 8€ during a sale) because I was expecting Gears 6 to be announced/released for this year but it looks like it won't happen, but then I saw the trailer for Space Marine 2 (which will indeed come out this year) and I was really intrigued so I've decided to (partially) fill the waiting by playing this game.

If you like me are looking for a "Gears of War" like game you won't be disappointed even if this one resemble GoW for almost anything except the base mechanic: there is no cover here. The campaign is short but enjoyable, obviously don't expect some ground breaking narrative, but for the approximately 6 hours that it last it does its job.

I was also able to play some multiplayer coop (horde mode) during weekends with quite a short wait time, which can satisfy some shooting itches but it lacks some depth so you I don't think I will come back often to it, but its nice to know that mp still works and being p2p it just rely on the game itself without the need of mods or custom servers.

For being a 2011 game it holds up very well, just be prepared for some very questionable collisions detection, but beside that I didn't found anything to complain and in general its quite fun. I will definetely go for the 2nd chapter when it will be out.

I would never suggest this for the current full price, but during sales this is must buy for people who enjoys shooters.
Just played this game for the 3rd time, and I forgot how great it is! This game is the best! Great environments, good story, fun gameplay. Highly recommend, especially if you're a 40k fan
one of the best games in the warhammer world to ever be made
